FAQ - South Park Commons Apply Residency Companies Writing Our Story Residency Companies Team Writing Events India FAQ Menu Our Story Residency Companies Team Writing Events India FAQ Residency Companies Writing Our Story Residency Companies Team Writing Events India FAQ Menu Our Story Residency Companies Team Writing Events India FAQ Apply Frequently Asked Questions About SPC Applying to SPC Residency Funding Who are your members? Around 70% of our members are founders who aspire to start a company and 30% are researchers and experts looking to go deeper in new fields (e.g. contribute to open-source software, write books, conduct research, etc). While most members are technical, we do make exceptions. We have roughly 175 active members and over 1300 alumni. Our active members are primarily split between hubs in San Francisco, New York City, and Bangalore. Do I need to be located in San Francisco, New York City, or Bangalore to be a member? Yes. Members are expected to come into SPC throughout the week, which usually means that folks need to be located in SF, NYC, or Bangalore. What is the difference between residency and funding? We're purposefully flexible because going from -1 to 0 looks different for everyone. Some people join us before they've committed to starting a company, others come to us already ready for funding, many move from one to the other while they're here.
